description: An unexpected attribute in a dynamic block is an error even when the collection is empty
notes: The README says the generated blocks are read as if they were written in place of the dynamic block, and an empty collection generates none, so this mistake affects no block. hashicorp/hcl reads the dynamic block with a schema of its own attributes and blocks (dynamicBlockBodySchemaNoLabels in ext/dynblock/schema.go) before it evaluates for_each (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
reference_error: An argument named "other" is not expected here
